directory_policies.notes.7: Preparation: Declare programming, data structures, computer organization and at least one year of college mathematics at calculus level or above. A single calculus-course checkbox does not establish the year requirement. Deficiencies require individual review.

fact_summary: The professional CS route specifies programming, data structures, machine organization and a year of mathematics at calculus level or above; generic single-course calculus is not that duration claim.
